rows.role_title: State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The FW de Klerk Foundation's transcript is headed as a speech by de Klerk 'following his inauguration as the second executive State President', dated 20 September 1989. In it he calls it his 'first public address after my inauguration as State President' and says that 'The new government will be installed tomorrow'.
